description: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life...

description: Lia is in love with her boyfriend, Milo, until she has feelings for their new roommate, Brianna; Milo catches them cheating and Brianna goes missing, things take a dark turn and a menacing sugar daddy becomes the prime suspect.

description: Three years after graduation, college friends Hope, Chanta and May eagerly reunite for Hope's wedding to her fiancé, Robert. As the weekend unfolds, a secret emerges. When the truth comes to light, the celebration descends into chaos.

description: After serving 17 years in prison, Travis Cane returns home to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family. But his once bright son, Dontae is acting out and abandons his goals in basketball for a life on the streets.

description: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women's group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality.

title: Kinfolk
description: Eboni is a hair stylist dreaming of owning a successful salon in her hometown, with the support of her half-siblings Beau and Hillary. Things get complicated when their father attempts to reconcile for the past.

title: Hidden Agenda
description: Bright and gifted Jessica takes on a side hustle tutoring popular football star, Ryan. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When Ryan is found dead, multiple people are suspects.

title: Garrett Morris and Michael Schultz
description: The story of the careers of legendary actor Garrett Morrison and legendary movie director Michael Schultz. Follow their life and career from their early beginnings to adulthood and becoming worldwide legendary artists from Broadway to Hollywood.

title: When Girls Ride
description: When Samantha leaves the South for a fresh start with her husband, she meets biker girls Raquel and Tammy. The three women grow close, and decide to start their own female bike club. Things take a turn for the worse when they lose a girl to violence.

description: Paroled after five years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by Benny, and her mother; their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder.

title: He Killed My Sister
description: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

title: A Secret Lie in Love
description: Clarice and Chase Scott have the perfect suburban life on the outside. But, their marriage that was built on passion, has become a battlefield of deceit, infidelity and betrayal. Clarice finds solace in the arms of another man.

title: The Loyalty Test
description: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star who has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. When two participants are found murdered, Trey's world begins to crumble.

description: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins

title: Broken Harmony
description: Harmony is on the verge of being dropped from her record label; her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta to refresh her sound; she must reunite with her mother and is forced to face her childhood trauma.

title: Widower Syndrome
description: Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone.

title: Trapped in the Game: Fool Me Once
description: Dallas Bush is assigned to take down a powerful drug lord, when he learns the payout could cover his dying mother's medical bills. Dallas must navigate a dangerous web of deception, crime, and moral compromise, where every choice comes with a price.

title: WOKE
description: A young college student, raised to her have biased opinions about the racial injustices, meets a young man he parents do not approve of.

title: The Wake Up Call
description: Stefan Malone, a gifted student in science and math, is crushed when he finds out about his mother's cancer diagnosis. He dedicates his life and research to finding a cure at Emerson, but will his dedication and determination may consume him.

title: Mistress for Hire
description: Skylar, a professional seductress hired for divorce leverage, falls for her target. As their connection grows, she reveals the truth, angering his wife. A dangerous game ensues, with love and survival on the line.

title: Who's Watching Us
description: When Ruth is hired to babysit for the Harris family, she and the kids find out that someone else is watching them closely. Ruth and Jasmine must fight to protect themselves and her little brother Micah.

title: Rhythm and Revenge
description: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her.

title: Desperate Desires
description: Marathon runner Mia is pursued by Jay, while Tori and Paul desire a baby. A one-night stand leaves Mia pregnant, creates an opportunity for Tori and Paul. When Mia disappears, a darker plot ensues. Whose desires will prevail?

title: How Did We Get Here
description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity.

title: One More Day
description: A single mother and her 15-year-old daughter's relationship is strained as the mother's career grows.

title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
description: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart.

title: The Barista
description: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price.

title: Kill for You
description: A struggling single mother finds love again with her son's track coach, but her seemingly fresh start is tested by his deeply racist father.

title: Unintended Consequences
description: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother's honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

title: The Laundry Room Stalker
description: A string of murders on local neighborhood sex workers have been occurring around one specific apartment building's laundry room. But all suspicion points to the newly hired attendant, Calvin who was just released from prison for 12 years.

title: Game of Cards
description: When data analyst Nicole Tucker's car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she's thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal.

title: Bottle Girl
description: Diamond's dream of going to college is threatened by financial hardship. A desperate job at a glamorous Atlanta lounge exposes her to a world of temptation and danger.

title: I Hate I Love You
description: A successful power couple is tested by betrayal and illegal activity. Both love and business face being destroyed.

title: Intrigue
description: Jessica and Darren's marriage has hit a rocky stage in their lives. When a mysterious man named Michael enters her life, Jessica is intrigued explores options that could have deadly consequences.
